verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat accepts natural-language questions across meetings and connected apps and can draft follow-ups, reports, and content. Natural-language search covers past calls and CRM data, and the MCP server lets Claude and ChatGPT search, recap, and draft from Otter data. However, the evidence covers querying and content generation only, not operating the product itself (e.g., scheduling the notetaker, sharing, or configuring settings) by command. Missing for 10: natural-language control of product actions and settings, documentation of the command scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
